clearly-calendula-morning.description: Start your day with our energizing organic black tea blend crafted for a beauty-from-within ritual. This enhanced Earl Grey combines premium Assam and Qu Hao black teas with lavender, spearmint, vanilla, peppermint, and calendula petals. The smooth Earl Grey flavor with hints of mint and vanilla provides lasting energy, with botanicals traditionally used in skincare and antioxidants that support clear, healthy-looking skin. Drink one or two cups in the morning to energize and hydrate as part of your daily routine. 100% USDA Certified Organic.

clearly-calendula-afternoon.description: Power through your afternoon with our refreshing organic green tea blend crafted for a healthy-glow ritual and sustained energy. This unique blend combines premium Dragonwell and Sencha green teas with lemon verbena, spearmint, peppermint, and calendula petals. Perfect hot or iced, at work, school, or the gym. Calendula, spearmint, and lemon verbena are botanicals long cherished in skincare, and green tea is naturally rich in antioxidants. Enjoy smooth, long-lasting energy while supporting clear, healthy-looking skin. 100% USDA Certified Organic.

clearly-calendula-evening.description: Wind down your day with our soothing caffeine-free herbal blend crafted for evening relaxation and your overnight skincare ritual. This calming tea combines organic chamomile, rooibos, spearmint, peppermint, and calendula petals. Chamomile and calendula are botanicals traditionally cherished for a calming routine, while rooibos is naturally rich in antioxidants. Enjoy before bed to unwind as part of your evening self-care. 100% USDA Certified Organic and completely caffeine-free.

Experience a full day of skincare tea benefits: energize in the morning, maintain focus in the afternoon, and relax in the evening while supporting your beauty-from-within routine around the clock. All teas are 100% USDA Certified Organic with compostable tea bags made from sugarcane. The perfect introduction to beauty from within, or a thoughtful gift for tea and skincare enthusiasts.
